draft.subject: Having the foundation endowment ready for May 2027
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

I know how much it matters to you that the foundation is endowed on the timetable you have set, and that you are there for the signing. I would like to make sure the money is ready for that day, and not only that it exists.

The initial endowment is USD 7,500,000, which is 17% of your wealth with us, and it is due in May 2027. Having the amount is one thing; having it in cash on that date without selling something at an awkward moment is another, and it is the part I would like us to plan now.

What I would suggest is that we agree which holdings will fund the endowment and set a date, comfortably before the signing, by which the cash should be in place.

Could I call you this week to go through it?
